config.content:
# Shipyard Deploy project configuration.
# Schema: contracts/schemas/project-config.schema.json
#
# This file is a default, never an authority. Precedence, weakest first:
#   built-in default < this file < SHIPYARD_DEPLOY_* env < command-line flag
# The Gradle plugin adds one rung: this file < shipyardDeploy { } DSL.
version: 1

# Control plane. SHIPYARD_DEPLOY_SERVER and --server both override it.
server: https://shipyard-deploy-dev.patjackson52.workers.dev

project: droidbridge

# What this repository publishes. `signer` is documentation: the CLI checks
# the real signature against the fingerprints registered on the package.
packages:
  dev.droidbridge.companion.dev: { variant: development, signer: droidbridge-development }

# Branch to channel routing. An exact `branch` match wins; otherwise the
# first `branch: "*"` rule does. {branch_slug} is the branch lowercased,
# non-alphanumerics collapsed to '-', truncated to 40 characters.
channels:
  main: { branch: main, mode: AUTO_INSTALL_WHEN_ALLOWED, ttl: 7d }
  default: { branch: "*", channel: "dev-{branch_slug}", mode: NOTIFY, ttl: 48h }

steps.name: project
steps.detail: project "droidbridge" does not exist and this token cannot create it (admin only)
